title: How to do the Glide /Slide / Side Walk  || Step by step Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates footwork from a low-angle camera perspective, breaking down each sliding and pointing movement step by step. He explains directional shifts and posture adjustments verbally while showing the foot mechanics.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces himself and the channel.
Instructor introduces the sidewalk or gliding dance move.
Instructor demonstrates footwork step by step from a front view angle.
Full demonstration of the sidewalk move against a white wall.
Closing remarks and promotion of other tutorials.

cues: Put your right leg or your left leg
Give a push to the left side
Point the other toe in the outer direction
common_mistakes: Not moving the foot in the correct direction and pointing straight inside

steps_taught.name: Sidewalk / Glide
steps_taught.description: Sliding the feet outward and inward with heel and toe pivots.

what_works: Low angle camera focuses clearly on foot placement
Step-by-step breakdown of toe and heel directions
what_hinders: Upper body is cropped out during foot breakdowns

quotes.text: In this video I'll teach you how to do the sidewalk which is also called gliding.
Okay first step put your right leg or your left leg I don't care.
You can increase your up down motion to make it look more confusing.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates foot placement and pushes to the side.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: weight distribution and full body posture

extraction.distinctive_method: Uses an image inset of a flying squirrel to visually explain the gliding concept.
